description: If you're interested in learning more about Amendments 4 & 5, my campaign, or you just want to say hi, come see me at the Dandy Lion Friday morning!I'll be there to answer questions, listen to your concerns, and have a conversation about the issues that matter most to our community. Whether you're still making up your mind or simply want to connect, I'd love to see you.See you Friday morning!
